title: What an amazing app!
body: I’ve been playing videogames since I can remember and I always found ironic that I could easily thick boxes and complete quests in whatever RPG I was playing at the time, but god forbid I did a to-do list IRL for things that were really inportant hahaha This app managed to embed a friendly experience to something that I loath doing for myself. Thank you so much developers! Hope you all know the amazing impact your product is doing amongst friends, coworkers and families :)

title: Great for boring tasks you need to do

author: enjhsbwowbqodboebqpdb

title: Amazing App
body: Takes some initial learning to understand the rules and features at the beginning but it is worth it in the end. I have never been more productive in my life than I am now. I used to constantly procrastinate, not follow up on things and let plans fall through. This app has given me great accountability and even simple things I struggled with before like making my bed, cleaning my room and following up on emails I find myself doing with ease everyday in order to level myself up. I tried to use many other habit tracking apps before but always gave up after a week but the features, user interface and most importantly the community for this app has made me stick with it and I feel happier overall in life and I don’t feel like I’m wasting my time anymore.
